messages:
Maya Ortiz: Quick follow-up from the policy engine sync: proposing we decompose routing into Filter -> CandidateExpander -> Scorer. Filter prunes by hard constraints (region, model compatibility, tenant blocklist). CandidateExpander handles cheap augmentations (replica health, recent-failure dampening). Scorer runs more expensive heuristics (latency prediction, cost, per-tenant weights). Thoughts?

Evan Song: I like adding CandidateExpander as an explicit step. we currently bake health and recent failures into the scorer which makes caching hard. if Expander normalizes that into a per-route penalty, scoring can be simpler and more cache-friendly.

Priya Nair: two operational concerns: 1) where do we run Expander (edge vs central) given it needs near-real-time health signals; 2) Expander must be cheap or we lose benefit of pre-filtering. we should define SLOs for each stage.

Ben Walker: agree. propose SLOs: Filter < 0.5ms median, Expander < 2ms median, Scorer p99 < 10ms (for host-tier). Also: make Expander results soft-cacheable for ~5s using last-seen telemetry to prevent thundering.

Maya Ortiz: good SLOs. design note: cache keys should include only deterministic inputs: filter inputs + expander-stable-bucket (e.g., healthy/unhealthy/unknown) and model-version. telemetry like recent-p95 should be tagged volatile and not part of cache key.

Evan Song: Regarding interface ergonomics for plugins: I propose each stage exposes a small JSON-serializable manifest describing inputs, outputs, and which outputs are volatile. runtimes can then enforce cache and explainability policies automatically.

Priya Nair: +1. also add a version field to manifests so we can rollout staged changes without mismatching old cache entries. and validators to ensure plugin outputs are bounded (e.g., score must be between -100 and +100).

Ben Walker: migration path idea: implement new pipeline in parallel as a "shadow path". for N tenants we compare final decisions and surface diffs (route chosen, reason codes). only when diffs under X% for a week do we flip traffic. Also needed: a flag to force legacy monolithic policy for a tenant.

Maya Ortiz: good. explainability: each stage must emit a short reason token (filter: REQ_REGION_MISMATCH, expander: ROUTE_DEPRIORITIZED_DUE_TO_FAILURE_RATE, scorer: SCORE_COMPONENTS=latency:0.7,cost:0.3). keep the token set small and documented. this helps Console and Optimize to attribute regressions.

Evan Song: security/privacy: expander may touch tenant-specific telemetry. we must gate which keys plugins can access and audit accesses. add telemetry-allowlist and runtime enforcement in the scorer host.

Priya Nair: ops alerts to add: sudden increase in candidate count (could indicate filter misconfig), spike in Expander fallback-to-unknown (telemetry outage), and divergence-rate between legacy and new pipeline.

deploy-bot: deploy:policy-pipeline-shim v0.2 rolled to canary-5 at 2026-03-21T15:34Z :white_check_mark:

Maya Ortiz: action items: Evan to draft plugin manifest schema + volatile-output annotations; Ben to sketch cache-key rules and expander bucketing; Priya to enumerate required SLOs and alerts; I'll update the RFC with pipeline diagrams and migration checklist. Thanks all :)
